document.abstract: The development of synthetic color-forming binders and their application to photographic emulsions is discussed. These accomplishments have made possible the manufacture of a release positive color film designated Du Pont Type 275. * A resume of some of the novel features of the stock is given and the utilization of the material as a color release medium is covered. Details of the printing and processing of both picture and sound records are given.
